description: Two pitch shifters built from a short delay line read at a changing speed, which gives the shift a tape-like character.

params.text: How far the second shifter moves the pitch.
How far the first shifter moves the pitch.
How much the MOD1 jack moves the first shifter's pitch.
How much the MOD2 jack moves the second shifter's pitch.
The length of the window the shifters read from, which trades smoothness against delay.
How much the MOD3 jack moves both shifters' pitch.
Sets how the two shifters are used: up shifts the left and right inputs separately, middle drives the two shifts in opposite directions, down shifts IN 1 alone and places it across the stereo pair.

inputs.text: Moves both shifters' pitch, by as much as the third MOD knob allows.
Moves the second shifter's pitch, by as much as the MOD knob beside the second SHIFT allows.
Moves the pitch of both shifters together at one volt per octave.
Moves the first shifter's pitch, by as much as the MOD knob beside SHIFT allows.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
